meaning_cn: 收心专注·排除杂念开干
trap_x:
字面意思：把自己锁起来，
关屋里不出来了
trap_check:
真正意思：别分心，进入状态，
一门心思把手头事干好

examples.en: I really had to lock in last night.
examples.cn: 我昨晚真是拼了，专注复习

examples.en: Until the series is completed, I stay locked in.
examples.cn: 系列赛没打完前，我一直全神贯注

examples.source: BBC Learning English 听众例句 2026
examples.en: I just need to lock in and get some stuff done.
examples.cn: 我就得进入状态，把手头事干完
